headline: Sensex Ends Lower Amid Tata Leadership Conflict and Hawkish Fed Stance
why: Hawkish Fed turn creates investor anxiety regarding future rate hikes
Internal conflict at Tata Sons over Chairman reappointment legality
PSU general insurers reporting significant losses and deteriorating solvency ratios
whatHappening: Sensex closed marginally lower while Nifty held above 23,250 levels
Tata Trusts led by Noel Tata declared Chandrasekaran's reappointment illegal
Indian steel exports retain 80% FTA benefits despite EU curbs
PSU general insurers swing to a massive ₹10,051-crore loss

stocksInNews.sources: EU curbs fail to dent India steel push
Tata Trusts terms Chandrasekaran reappointment illegal and IT drags
PSU general insurers swing to ₹10,051-crore loss

summary: Indian markets faced volatility as Sensex ended lower following a hawkish Fed outlook and leadership disputes within the Tata Group. While metals and pharma sectors showed resilience, PSU insurers struggled with massive losses and deteriorating solvency.
